candidates.change_summary: Delete the assignment that credits the owner's balance, so balances[owner] stays 0 after XBornID().
Credit the owner with totalRemaining instead of totalDistributed, so balances[owner] after XBornID() is 300000000e18 instead of 200000000e18.
Delete the recipient balance update in distr, so tokens distributed via getTokens never appear in balances.
Change totalRemaining subtraction to addition, so totalRemaining grows and getTokens' clamp/require logic yields different distributed amounts (hence different balances).
Delete the statement that decrements allowed[_from][msg.sender] by _amount in transferFrom, leaving the allowance unchanged.
Replace the allowance subtraction with an addition so transferFrom increases allowed[_from][msg.sender] by _amount instead of decreasing it.
Replace the allowance subtraction with a direct assignment to _amount so the remaining allowance always equals _amount after the call.
